channel.title: Weekly Delight
channel.description: 5555 well-known recipes from around the world, explained step by step

item.title: Salt Potatoes
item.description: Salt potatoes: small new potatoes boiled for 25 minutes in heavily salted water, then buttered. Six servings.

item.title: Hot Fudge Sundae
item.description: Hot fudge sundae with a warm cocoa and cream fudge sauce. Four servings, ready in 20 minutes.

item.title: Huli Huli Chicken
item.description: Huli huli chicken: Hawaiian-style chicken marinated in pineapple, soy and ginger, grilled for 45 minutes. Six servings, plus marinating.

item.title: Mojo Pork
item.description: Mojo pork: shoulder marinated in garlic, orange and lime, roasted for 3 hours until tender. Eight servings, plus marinating.

item.title: Walking Tacos
item.description: Walking tacos: corn chip bags filled with taco beef, cheese and toppings, ready in 25 minutes. Six servings.

item.title: Sweet and Sour Meatballs
item.description: Sweet and sour meatballs baked and glazed in a pineapple and vinegar sauce, cooked for 25 minutes. Eight servings.

item.title: Chopped Cheese Sandwich
item.description: Chopped cheese sandwich: griddled minced beef and onion under melted cheese in a soft roll. Two servings, ready in 20 minutes.

item.title: Clam Cakes
item.description: Clam cakes: chopped clams in a thick batter, fried until golden. Six servings, ready in 30 minutes.

item.title: Rhode Island Clam Chowder
item.description: Rhode Island clam chowder: clear broth with clams, bacon and potatoes, simmered for 35 minutes. Six servings.

item.title: Stuffies
item.description: Stuffies: stuffed clams baked with chorizo, breadcrumbs and herbs for 25 minutes. Six servings.

item.title: Spiedies
item.description: Spiedies: marinated chicken skewers grilled for 15 minutes and served in soft rolls. Four servings, plus marinating.

item.title: Horseshoe Sandwich
item.description: Horseshoe sandwich: toast, burger patty, chips and a warm cheese sauce, cooked for 25 minutes. Four servings.

item.title: Maxwell Street Polish
item.description: Maxwell Street Polish: grilled sausage on a bun with fried onions and mustard. Four servings, ready in 20 minutes.

item.title: Hatch Chile Cheeseburger
item.description: Hatch chile cheeseburger: grilled beef patties with roasted green chiles and melted pepper jack. Four servings, ready in 35 minutes.

item.title: Anadama Bread
item.description: Anadama bread: a yeast loaf with cornmeal and molasses, baked for 40 minutes. Ten slices, plus rising.

item.title: Pretzel Buns
item.description: Pretzel buns: yeast buns dipped in baking soda water and baked for 20 minutes. Eight buns, plus rising.

item.title: Classic Hollandaise
item.description: Hollandaise sauce: egg yolks, butter and lemon whisked over gentle heat for 10 minutes. Four servings, ready in 15 minutes.

item.title: Compound Butter
item.description: Compound butter with garlic, parsley and lemon, rolled and chilled. Eight servings, plus chilling.

item.title: Homemade Ricotta
item.description: Homemade ricotta from milk, cream and lemon juice, heated for 15 minutes and drained. Makes about 300 g, plus draining.

item.title: Homemade Ghee
item.description: Homemade ghee: butter simmered slowly for 25 minutes and strained into a clear golden fat. Makes about 20 spoonfuls.

item.title: Shortcrust Pastry
item.description: Shortcrust pastry for pies and tarts, rubbed in by hand, chilled and baked blind for 20 minutes. Makes one 23 cm case.

item.title: Fresh Egg Pasta
item.description: Fresh egg pasta from flour and eggs, rested for 30 minutes and cooked for 3 minutes. Four servings, plus resting.

item.title: Hoisin Sauce
item.description: Hoisin sauce made from soy sauce, peanut butter, molasses and garlic, simmered for 10 minutes. Makes about 240 ml.

item.title: Moo Shu Pork
item.description: Moo shu pork: pork, cabbage, mushrooms and egg stir-fried with hoisin and rolled in pancakes. Four servings.

item.title: Kung Pao Shrimp
item.description: Kung pao shrimp: prawns, peanuts and dried chillies in a tangy, spicy sauce, stir-fried fast. Four servings, ready in 25 minutes.
